name: SolarEdge
summary: DC-optimised inverter systems with per-panel monitoring — the usual answer for roofs with shading or multiple orientations.
metaTitle: SolarEdge Inverters & Optimisers | Advanced Solar Tech
metaDescription: SolarEdge inverter and power optimiser systems supplied and installed in Victoria. Per-panel monitoring and strong performance on shaded or complex roofs.
intro: SolarEdge pairs a central inverter with a power optimiser on each panel. Because each panel is managed individually, one shaded module no longer drags down the whole string — which is why it is the common specification on roofs with a chimney, a neighbouring tree or several different orientations.
strengths: Per-panel optimisation limits the impact of localised shading
Panel-level monitoring makes a single underperforming module easy to find
Suits complex roofs with multiple orientations and pitches
Module-level rapid shutdown for safety
considerations: There is more hardware on the roof than a string system — an optimiser per panel. On a genuinely unshaded, single-orientation roof, a straightforward string inverter often delivers the same yield for less. We specify SolarEdge where the roof justifies it.

name: Sungrow
summary: High-volume inverter manufacturer with a broad residential, hybrid and commercial range.
metaTitle: Sungrow Inverters & Hybrid Systems | Advanced Solar Tech
metaDescription: Sungrow string and hybrid inverters supplied and installed in Victoria, including battery-ready hybrid models for later storage.
intro: Sungrow is one of the largest inverter manufacturers globally, with a range spanning small residential string inverters through hybrid units to large commercial three-phase systems. The hybrid models are frequently specified where a battery is planned but not being bought yet.
strengths: Wide range covering residential through to commercial scale
Hybrid models accept DC-coupled batteries without a second inverter
Established local support presence in Australia
Competitive pricing at volume
considerations: String inverters are more sensitive to shading than DC-optimised systems. On a roof with real shading, either add optimisers or plan the string layout carefully — the difference in annual yield is not marginal.

name: GoodWe
summary: Hybrid and string inverters with a strong battery-ready range at accessible price points.
metaTitle: GoodWe Inverters & Hybrid Systems | Advanced Solar Tech
metaDescription: GoodWe string and hybrid inverters supplied and installed in Victoria, including battery-ready models with backup capability.
intro: GoodWe's hybrid range is widely used where a household wants storage capability without paying for a premium-brand inverter. The ET-series hybrids support backup circuits, which matters where blackout resilience is part of the reason for buying.
strengths: Strong hybrid range at accessible pricing
Backup circuit support on hybrid models
Compatible with a range of third-party batteries
Broad availability in the Australian market
considerations: Battery compatibility is model-specific — not every GoodWe inverter pairs with every battery. We confirm the exact pairing on your quote rather than leaving it to be discovered at commissioning.

name: Huawei
summary: Inverters with optional per-panel optimisers and integrated storage options.
metaTitle: Huawei Solar Inverters & Optimisers | Advanced Solar Tech
metaDescription: Huawei FusionSolar inverters and optimisers supplied and installed in Victoria, with optional per-panel optimisation and integrated battery options.
intro: Huawei's FusionSolar range offers optimisers as an option rather than a requirement, so the same inverter can serve a simple roof without optimiser cost and a shaded roof with them. That flexibility is useful when a house has one problem section and an otherwise clear roof.
strengths: Optimisers optional rather than mandatory — pay for them only where needed
Integrated storage options within the same product family
Detailed monitoring and diagnostics
Arc-fault detection on supported models
considerations: Some organisations and commercial tenders apply procurement restrictions to Huawei equipment. If that applies to your site or your insurer, tell us early and we will specify an alternative.

name: SAJ
summary: Budget-conscious string and hybrid inverters for straightforward roofs.
metaTitle: SAJ Solar Inverters | Advanced Solar Tech
metaDescription: SAJ string and hybrid inverters supplied and installed in Victoria. A value option for simple, unshaded roof layouts.
intro: SAJ sits at the value end of the inverter market. On a simple, unshaded, single-orientation roof, a well-installed SAJ string inverter does the same job as a more expensive unit, and the saving can be redirected into more panels — which usually does more for the bill.
strengths: Lower up-front cost than premium inverter brands
Hybrid models available for later battery addition
Straightforward installation and commissioning
Suits simple roof layouts well
considerations: Value-tier inverters typically carry shorter standard warranties and a thinner local support network than premium brands. Over a 20-year system life the inverter is the component most likely to need replacing — worth weighing against the up-front saving.

name: LG Energy Solution
summary: Lithium-ion home battery systems from an established global cell manufacturer.
metaTitle: LG Energy Solution Home Batteries | Advanced Solar Tech
metaDescription: LG Energy Solution home battery systems supplied and installed in Victoria, with compatibility confirmed against your inverter before quoting.
intro: LG Energy Solution manufactures the cells as well as the battery system, which is not true of every brand in this market. For a product expected to cycle daily for a decade or more, cell provenance is a reasonable thing to care about.
strengths: Cells manufactured in-house rather than sourced and packaged
Established global manufacturer with long production history
Compatible with a range of hybrid inverters
High round-trip efficiency
considerations: Battery and inverter compatibility is specific — check the pairing rather than assuming it. Product availability in the Australian market has shifted over time, so we confirm current supply before quoting.
